svg.text: Child Agent's model requests write

svg.text: Layer 1 allowedTools (model layer)

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

svg.text: tools list sent to the model is allowlist-filtered

svg.text: Layer 2 readOnlyAgents (runtime layer)

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

svg.text: permission check: read-only role + risk ≠ low → deny

svg.text: deny wins over configured allow (evaluate.ts rule 2)
